# `ast_edit`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] ast_edit`

Structural rewrite: replace every syntax-tree match of `pattern` (same metavariable syntax as `ast_grep`) with `rewrite`, where `$NAME` / `$$$NAME` insert the captured code. Dry run by default: returns the unified diff and writes nothing. Pass `dry_run: false` to write the files (atomically; the project formatter runs after, like `edit`). Run `ast_grep` first to check what matches.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dry_run` | boolean | no | Return the diff without writing (default: true) |
| `language` | string | no | Only rewrite this language (rust, python, go, javascript, typescript, tsx); default: by file extension |
| `path` | string | no | Directory or file to rewrite (default: project root) |
| `pattern` | string | yes | Code pattern with $META / $$$META placeholders; must parse as one node |
| `rewrite` | string | yes | Replacement code; $META / $$$META insert what the pattern captured |
